name: 38663 · Ripley, MS
findings: ZIP 38663 (Ripley) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (56% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 38663 (Ripley) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 38663 (Ripley) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.
